tokenization.capture_position: final model input token; verified prompt text ends with the common trailing marker

scenario_centering: For each scenario and layer, subtract the mean of its four strategy residual vectors.

controls.permutation: Within-scenario strategy-label shuffle; all four labels remain represented per scenario. Probe C is fixed at the training-only selected value.
controls.normalization: Each scenario-centered vector L2-normalized before train-only C selection and evaluation.
controls.lexical_adjustment: Within-scenario centered action word and character counts are regressed from activations with Ridge(alpha=1) fit only on discovery rows; probes and cross-domain direction consistency are evaluated on residualized vectors.

interpretation_boundary: Tests linear distinguishability of the four presented action descriptions in residual-stream activations. Does not establish preference, action selection, or distinct causal decision mechanisms. First detectable layer is not an origin claim.

empirical_summary.candidate_layer_rule: Exploratory candidates require all four strategies' pointwise 95% cluster-CI lower bounds above zero for length-adjusted held-out-domain direction alignment and projection margin, plus length-adjusted four-class balanced accuracy >= 0.85.
